set.body: Third radial latent slice. Convert RadialBasis to an LNA SharedBasisArtifact with kind=hrbf metadata and add a RadialBasisEncoder path that delegates to SharedBasisEncoder. Acceptance: artifact mask/index validation, encode/reconstruct synthetic data in radial span, metadata preserves kernel/threshold/index semantics, JVM+JS latent tests pass.
